verdict.rationale: ByteAsk explicitly supports signing in via magic-link email tied to your account/subscription plan (no API key needed), shows current plan usage, and auto-upgrades your plan on payment without re-authentication, directly matching the story of using an existing subscription to access the agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the sign-in and plan-linking flow, and details on how different subscription tiers map to agent capabilities.
